summary.plain: Over 250 researchers from about 50 institutions worldwide, combining the expertise of the earlier GERDA and Majorana Demonstrator teams, who run the LEGEND germanium neutrino experiment.
summary.technical: International collaboration (>250 researchers, ~50 institutions per the collaboration's own page) formed from the GERDA and MAJORANA DEMONSTRATOR teams to operate the staged LEGEND-200/LEGEND-1000 germanium 0νββ programme at LNGS.
